name: Bjørn Møller
bio:
Bjørn Møller's journey into motorsport was a natural extension of his lifelong fascination with precision and engineering. From disassembling and reassembling his bicycle as a child to earning a degree in mechanical engineering, Bjørn's path has always been driven by a desire to understand how things work and how they can be improved. After university, he spent several years in the aerospace industry, developing a keen eye for detail and a rigorous approach to quality assurance.

He transitioned to motorsport after a chance encounter with Blau Motorsport's technical director at a local racing event. Bjørn was immediately captivated by the speed, the technology, and the relentless pursuit of perfection. As a quality control specialist, he brings his aerospace experience to bear, meticulously scrutinizing every component and process to ensure that Blau Motorsport's cars meet the highest standards of performance and reliability. His colleagues appreciate his methodical approach and his unwavering commitment to excellence, even under pressure. Bjørn believes that even the smallest improvements can make a significant difference on the track.

Bjørn's perfectionist nature, combined with his ambition to see Blau Motorsport succeed, drives him to constantly seek out areas for improvement. He's known for his innovative ideas, often suggesting unconventional solutions to complex problems. He has a unique ability to balance the need for speed with the demands of quality and safety.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Bjørn is of average height, with a slightly stocky build, and always wears glasses perched on his nose.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on personally inspecting every new shipment of parts, no matter how small.
